## Notes on Next Level-up (Level 4)

When Tiberius reaches **2,700 XP** and hits Level 4:

- Choose **ASI** (+2 to one score or +1 to two) **OR** a **Feat**
- Gain another spell slot (2nd becomes ×3)
- Add 2 spells to spellbook
- Suggestions: bump **INT to 18** (+4 mod, DC 14, Attack +6) or take **War Caster / Resilient (CON)**
